Reference error bar for I_AB, all three measured, not assumed:
- last-step change in the 5-D order ladders (worst config): 6.134e-07 Ha
- domain-truncation shift between f=5.0 and f=5.9 (worst): 2.026e-06 Ha
- Cartesian 3-D vs cylindrical 5-D disagreement at the top orders (worst): 7.965e-06 Ha
- adopted combined uncertainty U = 1.060e-05 Ha = 0.00665 kcal/mol

Per configuration.  `d_headline` = package inter[0,1] (PySCF production grid) - exact I_AB.  `d_partition` = same node set, Becke block minus density-factor block, so the grid cancels.  `d_grid` = the density-factor block minus the exact reference, i.e. what the grid itself costs.
